text:
invoice-bot: New invoice received from Halo Tech: INV-HT-331 for $6,720. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-HT-331. Vendor referenced PO: PO-15822. Auto-extracted lines: Software subscription $5,000 (PO-15822), Onsite workshop $1,720 (no PO). Please review.

maya_fin: Quick look  workshop was ad-hoc approved by PM but procurement never created a separate PO. Due in 9 days.

diego_proc: We don't have a PO for the workshop. Procurement policy requires PO for >$1k services. Options: request vendor reissue with PO or create retrospective PO-15823.

rita_ap: AP rules: invoice must match PO to auto-release. If we can't get a PO before due date we need an approval override with written manager sign-off.

owen_pm: I approved the workshop in email thread on 2026-03-18. Can we use that email as approval? I can also approve here: "I approve Halo Tech workshop $1,720 charged to ENG-TRAINING."

shelly_ops: Ops prefers vendor to reissue with PO so budgets stay tidy. But timeline matters — if procurement can create PO-15823 fast, vendor will reissue.

vendor-bot: Halo Tech billing: "We can reissue invoice to include additional PO if you send PO number to billing@halotech.com. Otherwise we can accept payment referencing invoice only. Note: reissue typically takes 6 hours."

diego_proc: I'll open PR-2105 to create PO-15823 as retrospective for workshop. Routing for Eng manager and finance approval. ETA ~4 hours.

maya_fin: If PR-2105 can't be completed by EOD, we'll do override but attach Owen's email and ask procurement to note as retrospective PO later.

procurement-bot: PR-2105 created and flagged urgent. Please route approvals to @owen_pm and @maya_fin. Note: retrospective PO will be labeled with audit note.

vendor-bot: Halo confirms they will reissue once they receive PO-15823.

own_pm: Approved PO-15823.

maya_fin: Finance approves PO-15823. Diego, ping vendor to reissue and update AP ticket AP-9320.

diego_proc: Sent PO-15823 to billing@halotech.com. Requested reissue referencing PO-15822 and PO-15823.

vendor-bot: Halo Tech: "Reissued invoice INV-HT-331-R1 attached. Shows PO-15822 and PO-15823. Thank you."

rita_ap: Received reissued invoice. Removing HOLD-PO-MISSING. AP will match lines to respective POs and schedule payments for next run. AP ticket AP-9320 updated with attachments.

shelly_ops: Great — closing loop. Prep note for onboarding: PMs must request PR for >$1k services before vendor engagement.

maya_fin: Audit note added: "Retrospective PO created; vendor reissued invoice to include both PO numbers; manager email approval attached to AP ticket." Thread closed.
